authority: Document/Revision/Evidence/Statement contracts define knowledge identity; runtime_run.schema.json defines the optional extraction batch shape

knowledge_lifecycle.revision_replacement: mark the old Revision superseded, invalidate or rebuild only dependent Evidence, Statements and derived relationships, and retain shared Entity records
knowledge_lifecycle.invalidation_reason: withdrawn is a reason for invalid, not a separate lifecycle status
knowledge_lifecycle.stable_ids: unchanged source content keeps its existing Evidence and Statement identities when the owning producer contract permits it
knowledge_lifecycle.review_overlay: manual decisions bind to the exact Evidence or Statement identity and content/version fingerprint; mapping acceptance is separate from knowledge approval

extraction_batch.purpose: optional internal grouping for one automatic extraction operation

cache_policy.cache_key_and_implementation_context: implementation-only; never a knowledge, Evidence, Statement or Release identity
cache_policy.cache_scope: local stage runtime; structured output is referenced rather than copied into formal knowledge

provenance_policy.formal_chain: Document -> Revision -> Page/SourceSpan -> Evidence -> Engineering Statement -> Graph
provenance_policy.prov_o: not persisted as a separate authority; any projection is derived in memory from formal provenance

release_policy.neo4j_role: rebuildable projection of formal disk artifacts
